notes.subject: כחלת — penta
notes.rationale: Sehebera se kaya go penta mahlo ka sekoromokwa (antimony), setshwantsho sa go ipaakanyetsa bosiana

notes.subject: תשלחנה — bontsi kgotsa bongotsi
notes.rationale: Setshwantsho se bua le Oholiba jaaka motho a le mongwe wa bong boselee, mme kaelo ya Setswana e dirisa 'o romela'

notes.subject: שלח/שלוח
notes.rationale: Go boela ga lefoko 'go romela' gabedi mo temaneng — go romela le go boelwa morongwa, go latlhegelwa ke sebopego mo phetolelong

notes.subject: go Oholiba (Jerusalema)
notes.rationale: Temana e bua ka yunitse o o tlhamaletseng le setshwantsho sa kgarebe e e sennye

translation: Mme gape o ile wa ba romela ⟨את⟩ banna ba tswang kwa kgakala, ba ba neng ba rometswe morongwa go ba; mme bonwe, ba tsile; o ile wa itlapa ka ntlha ya bona, wa penta mahlo a gago, mme wa itshokisa ka diaparo tsa kgabo.
